title: Cosmic zoo explanation for diverse craft

tellings.quote: Um the idea that we're living in a cosmic zoo.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange lights and craft, floats the idea that we are living in a kind of cosmic zoo, with Earth watched by many different visitors. The owner raises it on the show as a possible reason so many different kinds of craft are reported, which would mean more than one kind of outsider is taking an interest in us.
